author: Prodalo
body:
Hi, Yesterday someone ban me for hacking (Aimbot). But my problem is , that my brother hack, not me. I wasen't logged out on my computer, so that my brother could play with my minecraft accaunt called Danostratos.

I will like to say sorry hacking. In the future I will be more careful, that no one else can play with my Account. 

I reade, that everybody get a second chance to get unbaned. I wasn't banned before and I play on this server more than 1 year.

So, i hope you can forgive me. And I will never hack again. :) :) :) :) :)

best regards: Daniel

(sorry my english, i am from Austria)

replies.body:
Hello,

It's your account and therefore your responsibility. Regardless of the fact that your brother was the one hacking, your account still caused trouble on the server. You will not be appealed.

Regards,
Pelpelajax,
Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
